title: Everlasting as the Moon
description: Spend some time with Columbina in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogs.text: What shall we play today?
Some music would be nice.
Let's play a picture-guessing game.
Let's mix some drinks.
Let's play Moon Chess.
Let's play Kuuhenki Hat-N-Seek.
I'm in!
Thank you. I enjoyed our time together.
Wherever you go, may this ray of moonlight linger upon you.
Go on now, little ones.
See if you can guess what this picture is.
The moon.
Hmph, that was way too obvious!
I'm afraid this riddle was a little too simple for us.
Unagi.
Hey, what's wrong with this eel's waist?
You two possess an impressive wealth of knowledge...
The correct answer is "the moon."
Come back now. You did a wonderful job.
An arc.
Anyone with eyes can see it's an arc! How could the answer be something so simple!?
While you aren't technically wrong, I'm afraid that's not exactly what the kuuhenki were going for.
The correct answer is "the moon."
Come back now. You did a wonderful job.
Go on now, friends.
All you need to do is guess what the picture is.
Knuckle Duckle.
How did you manage to guess that!?
So that's what it's called. Does it pick its creator up and carry her around in its hand?
Paimon thinks you might be confusing Aino with a former colleague of yours...
A Weasel Thief who's eaten too much.
Could a Weasel Thief this stuffed still steal stuff?
Or perhaps it no longer needs to steal?
The correct answer is "the big mechanical duck next to Aino's workshop."
Come back now. Thank you, I know that wasn't easy.
A flask.
Whoa, the kuuhenki learned what specialized lab equipment looks like just for this game? They're really going all out!
That's... very close.
The correct answer is "the big mechanical duck next to Aino's workshop."
How is that close!?
Come back now. Thank you, I know that wasn't easy.
Go on now, friends.
All you need to do is guess what the picture is.
The Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau.
Did you play this with the kuuhenki before and forget to tell us?
The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...
A Floating Anemo Fungus.
Uh... The body's got some resemblance, but is their cap really that round?
You got the "floating" part right, at least...
The correct answer is the "Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau."
The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...
Come back now. You really outdid yourselves.
An umbrella.
The handle seems a little short for an umbrella. How's anyone supposed to hold it?
An umbrella... isn't something I often use. Why not just make a kuuvahki shield when it rains?
Wait a sec! We can use that to keep the rain off, too!?
The correct answer is the "Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau."
The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...
Come back now. You really outdid yourselves.
Once the game is over, the kuuhenki rush toward you. They appear to be extremely happy.
Thank you for taking the time to play with the kuuhenki.
I hope we can have just as much fun playing together next time.
Thank you. I enjoyed our time together.
Wherever you go, may this ray of moonlight linger upon you.
In the future... I'll be sure to let you know.
Thank you. I enjoyed our time together.
Wherever you go, may this ray of moonlight linger upon you.
Perhaps... Like this?
Hmm, let me think...
Oh...
Moons... Moons...
How about here?
Looks like I won this round.
My three moons are connected.
Mm, this should win it.
Mm... The moons wax and wane in an endless cycle...
It seems both sets of moons refuse to be eclipsed.
Are we... heading for a tie?
Ah, you weigh your decisions carefully before making them, I see. Take your time — we have plenty of that, after all.
Did you forget how to place your moons in the night sky? Shall I help you?
You don't like this game? Hm... I find it quite amusing myself.
Mm? Are you staring at me? Your gaze is not subtle.
You're staring... Is the truth of the moons written on my face?
The board's over there, by the way...
Hm, your moons are aligned.
The night sky is yours.
Ah... I must have... slipped up somewhere.
You have a wonderful time playing the game with Columbina...
Thank you, I enjoyed that a lot.
If you'd like... feel free to come keep me company again, sometime.
Here, take this as a token of our promise.
Thank you. I enjoyed our time together.
Wherever you go, may this ray of moonlight linger upon you.
Thank you. I enjoyed our time together.
Wherever you go, may this ray of moonlight linger upon you.
Ah, you're here? The kuuhenki are playing the lyre again. Could you play a song for them like last time?
And I happen to be in the mood to hear something different myself.
(Hmm, what should I play...)
Let's try the one Columbina always sings...
Let's try the one Columbina always sings...
(But what tone should I go for...)
Let's try calm and gentle...
That was lovely. So you really did memorize my tune.
Hehe, only 'cause you're such a great singer! Whenever we hear your voice, sometimes we stop for a bit just to listen...
Hm, the kuuhenki seemed quite enraptured with your performance as well. Perhaps they picked up a few things...
I might require your educational assistance again in the future.
Come, give me your hand.
Huh? No, no, this was a free performance. No tuition fee required!
Hmm? Tuition fee?
I only thought... the gentle glow of moonlight would make a fitting accompaniment for such a beautiful melody.
Let's make it cheerful...
Oh, it's over already? I could listen to that forever...
As I once told you, this is the only lullaby I can remember.
Although I have yet to discern the meaning behind it, after hearing you play, I feel like whatever answer is waiting for me, up there on the moon... at the very least, it must be a beautiful one.
Here, give me your hand.
It's okay. Seriously, you don't need to give us anything in return.
Ah, that wasn't my intention... I only wished to adorn your melody with a ray of gentle moonlight.
Let's try something from another nation...
Let's try something from another nation...
How curious... I have heard melodies like this before, but your playing lends a whole new dimension...
#Ah, maybe because {NICKNAME} was channeling {M#his}{F#her} emotional connection to that place...
What's curious is that... I feel as if I can picture the landscape just by listening to the melody. I wonder how the real thing compares to my imagination...
You should just go see it someday! We can be your tour guides!
Mm... Perhaps. If that day ever comes.

That was lovely. So you really did memorize my tune.

We have pierced through cloud and fog, and together, witnessed the answer on the moon... Its beauty is like the music your strings now sing.

questNarration.text: Wow, even Paimon wants to try a glass of that...
I seem to have made a mistake somewhere... Let me try again.
